title: Remo
desc: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him.

title: Amma Ammaayiyamma
desc: Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.

title: Arrambam
desc: Ashok, a former member of the ATS, along with Arjun, a computer hacker, and his girlfriend Anitha, tries to unveil a scam involving the bulletproof jackets provided to police officers.

title: Maragadha Naanayam
desc: Senguttuvan and Elango team up with a priest to retrieve a cursed treasure.

title: Raid
desc: Inspector Prabhakaran takes an oath to eradicate criminals. However, chaos ensues when his fiancé gets killed in a crossfire.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.
